Opposite Party
 Coram :- Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ratnaker Bhengra

For the Petitioner :- Mr. A.K. Kashyap, Sr. Advocate ;
 Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate
 For the State :- Mr. Tarun Kumar, App
 ...
Heard both the counsels.
The petitioner is an accused in this case for the offence registered under sections 376(1) and 312 of the IPC.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that admittedly the allegations have been made after a long subsisting relationship for more than five years.
The alleged date of occurrence is 03.06.2023 but the relationship continued for at least 4-5 years.
The FIR was subsequently lodged on 16.06.2023, which is also delayed by around 12 days.
The allegation made is that the petitioner had sexually exploited the victim on the pretext of marriage and thereafter the petitioner has refused to marry the victim.
The learned counsel has further submitted that when refusal to marry was made, the case has subsequently been lodged.
According to the Doctor or medical report, she is around 17 to 19 years of age and as per the Jharkhand Academic Council's record, she is 19 years and 03 months.
The Doctor has not found any injury or any spermatozoa.
Moreover, the petitioner is in custody since 17.06.2023.
Therefore, the petitioner may be granted privilege of bail.

Learned counsel for the State, has vehemently opposed the bail application of the petitioner and has submitted that the allegation is of rape, on the pretext of marriage and in the statement under section 164 CrPC, she has also supported the prosecution case.

Having gone through the records of the case and arguments in the facts and circumstances, present petitioner, named above, is ordered to be released on bail on executing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj, in connection with Daltonganj Town Ranjan Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
